# BpsUtils
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/BpsUtils.sol)

**Title:**
BpsUtils

**Author:**
Roberto Cano

Utility library to apply basis-point calculations to input amounts

Mirrors the API of PercentageUtils, replacing the high-precision
PERCENTAGE_FACTOR with the standard BPS_FACTOR (10000).


## Functions
### addBps

Increases `amount` by `bps` basis points

Computes (BPS_100 + bps) * amount / BPS_FACTOR
e.g. addBps(1000, BPS.wrap(100)) returns 1010 (1% increase)


```solidity
function addBps(uint256 amount, BPS bps) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The base amount|
|`bps`|`BPS`|The basis points to add (must not exceed BPS_100)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount after the increase|


### subtractBps

Decreases `amount` by `bps` basis points

Computes (BPS_100 - bps) * amount / BPS_FACTOR
e.g. subtractBps(1000, BPS.wrap(100)) returns 990 (1% decrease)


```solidity
function subtractBps(uint256 amount, BPS bps) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The base amount|
|`bps`|`BPS`|The basis points to subtract (must not exceed BPS_100)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount after the decrease|


### applyBps

Applies `bps` directly to `amount`

Computes bps * amount / BPS_FACTOR
e.g. applyBps(1000, BPS.wrap(500)) returns 50 (5% of 1000)


```solidity
function applyBps(uint256 amount, BPS bps) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The base amount|
|`bps`|`BPS`|The basis points to apply|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The portion of amount represented by bps|


### isBpsInRange

Returns true if `bps` is a valid basis-point value (0 – 10000)


```solidity
function isBpsInRange(BPS bps) internal pure returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bps`|`BPS`|The value to check|


### fromFraction

Converts the fraction `numerator / denominator` into a BPS value

e.g. fromFraction(1, 4) returns BPS.wrap(2500) (25%)


```solidity
function fromFraction(uint256 numerator, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (BPS);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`numerator`|`uint256`|The numerator of the fraction|
|`denominator`|`uint256`|The denominator of the fraction|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`BPS`|The equivalent BPS value|
